content.comment_body: I'm working with a [product_name] device, but a password has been set and now I can't access it to make programming changes. Is there any way to remove the password and completely reset the device's programming? Thanks!
Hello [user_name], You can find a solution in this support article: How to delete the password on [product_name] [url] Best regards,

Dear [user_name], For removing a password, you usually need to know the existing password—this applies particularly to certain [article_no] hardware versions. Please refer to the user manual, page 76, for details. Cheers!

analysis.insight_summary: A user can't access or reprogram their [product_name] device due to a forgotten password. Community members pointed to official documentation and support resources. It was highlighted that for several hardware versions, knowledge of the current password is required to remove it. The main challenge is restoring device access when the password isn't known, which affects both usability and device recovery.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants a way to remove or bypass the password without knowing it and to reset or erase all current programming from the device.
